description:
Mandatory-field, type/format, and controlled-vocabulary checks for SOCIB's own extensions to the RDA DCS + OSTrails AP. There is no separate written specification: this file *is* the current specification of what SOCIB's pipeline produces beyond the two standards above. As in ostrails/1.0.0.json, structural parent nodes already defined by RDA DCS/OSTrails (dataset, distribution, project, project.funding, contributor) are redeclared here only with the cardinality and type needed to reach SOCIB's own new fields; the RDA/OSTrails-level checks on those entities remain the other two files' responsibility, and the merge collapses the duplication into one tree at load time.
'_suggested_values' on facility_area, dataflow_step, status, dataset.mode and data_flow.type / deployment_id.type / deployment.deployment_id.type list the values observed in the instruments' data_flow.json and in the DMPs generated today. They are deliberately non-strict (a mismatch is a warning, not a failure) because the real vocabulary is expected to grow as instruments and productions are added.
dataset.distribution.type_input/type_output are lists (1..n) even when a step produces a single value (e.g. ['raw']), so every distribution carries them with one consistent shape; some data flow steps (e.g. Processing) produce several at once (['L0','L1','L2']).
The placeholder-resolution recipes stay in the instrument's data_flow.json and are never written into a DMP at any level: the instrument builds leave them out of the baseline and the project DMP, and the deployment fill reads them from data_flow.json to substitute real values. No rules field describes them, on purpose.

acknowledgments._description: Acknowledgments for this DMP (e.g. facilities, funding, or people to credit).

stage._description: The data lifecycle stage(s) this contributor was involved in.

data_flow._chapter_description: The SOCIB data flows this DMP was generated from: for each, its identifier, type, and a URL to its definition. A DMP covering several instruments carries one per instrument.
data_flow._description: A SOCIB data flow this DMP was generated from.

identifier._description: Identifier of the data flow this DMP is generated from.

type._description: The type/source of the data flow identifier.

url._description: A URL pointing to the data flow definition.

dataflow_step._description: The data flow step that produced this distribution.

facility_area._description: The SOCIB facility area responsible for this distribution.

format_input._description: The format(s) of the input data consumed to produce this distribution.

path_input._description: The path or location of the input data consumed to produce this distribution.

platform_instrument._description: The platform/instrument that produced the underlying data.

status._description: The current status of this distribution.

technical_resource._description: Technical resources (hardware/software) used to produce this distribution.

description._description: What this technical resource is or does.

name._description: Name of the technical resource used to produce this distribution.

type_input._description: The data type(s) of the input consumed to produce this distribution (e.g. L0).

type_output._description: The data type(s) produced by this distribution (e.g. L1, L2).

mode._description: The acquisition mode for this dataset (e.g. real-time, delayed-time).

deployment._chapter_description: The specific instrument deployment this DMP was generated for: its code, identifier, dates, instrument, and platform.
deployment._description: The specific instrument deployment this DMP was generated for.

type._description: The type/source of the deployment identifier.

initial_date._description: The deployment's start date and time.

platform_name._description: Name of the platform the instrument was deployed on.

deployments._chapter_description: Summary of all deployments associated with this DMP's project: their count and a URL to the full list.
deployments._description: Summary of all deployments associated with this DMP's project.

count._description: The number of deployments associated with this DMP.

url._description: A URL pointing to the list of deployments.
